title: Additional Material

## Purpose

Use this page for optional additions when you have extra time, a more advanced cohort, or a strong local data example to work with.

## Optional Extensions

### Data Source Comparison

- Compare institutional data, survey data, open data, and manually collected data for the same question.
- Ask learners to identify what each source can and cannot justify.

### Data Cleaning Demonstration

- Show a before-and-after spreadsheet with inconsistent labels, missing values, and duplicated records.
- Ask learners which transformations should be documented.

### Visualisation Critique

- Use a gallery of charts with truncated axes, overloaded colour, missing labels, or weak context.
- Ask learners to rewrite the chart title as a claim and then test whether the chart supports it.

### Insight Communication

- Give learners one finding and three audiences.
- Ask them to adapt the emphasis without changing the evidence.
